rules.title: User app caches
rules.why_safe: Temporary data apps keep to load faster. Apps recreate it automatically when needed.
rules.rebuild_hint: Some apps may start a little slower the first time

rules.title: User logs & crash reports
rules.why_safe: Diagnostic text files written by apps. Only needed when you are reporting a bug.

rules.title: Safari cache
rules.why_safe: Copies of web pages and images. Safari downloads them again when you visit a site. History, bookmarks and logins are not touched.

rules.title: Google Chrome cache
rules.why_safe: Copies of web pages and images. Chrome downloads them again when you visit a site. History, bookmarks and logins are not touched.

rules.title: Trash
rules.why_safe: Files you already moved to the Trash. They stay restorable from the Restore Center for the retention period.

rules.title: Mail attachment copies
rules.why_safe: Copies of attachments you opened or previewed in Mail. The originals stay in your mailboxes, and Mail makes a new copy the next time you open one.

rules.title: Broken preference files
rules.why_safe: Settings files that are empty or damaged, so their app can't read them anyway. The app starts with default settings and saves a fresh file. Apple's own settings are never included.
rules.rebuild_hint: That app's settings go back to their defaults

rules.title: Photos analysis caches
rules.why_safe: Working files from the background analysis that recognises faces, scenes and text in your photos. They are rebuilt as needed. Your photos, albums and the analysis results in your library are not touched.
rules.rebuild_hint: Photos may re-analyse in the background for a while
